correctness.rationale: PASS: For fixed rank-r projection P, the block form of Q with PQ=0 is Q=[[0,0],[C,D]], D^2=D and DC=C. Fixing rank D=s and rank C=u gives the Gaussian factor times the exact rank-u rectangular matrix count. For R, images W lie in ker Q and avoid im P, giving [n-r-s+u choose t]_q q^{t(r-u)} images and q^{t(n-r-t)} projections per image. Their product is the stated formula. The nonempty-u criterion is equivalent to all three pairwise rank sums at most n; this proves extremal bounds and the closed even-dimensional count. Actual independent matrix enumerations for n<=4 (q=2), n<=3 (q=3), and q=4 n=2, plus extra formula checks, match every coefficient. Finite checks corroborate but do not establish the universal proof.

value.rationale: PASS: The rank-refined directed three-cycle count is a natural invariant of noncommutative zero-product adjacency among matrix idempotents. It identifies the complete parameter support, a sharp total-rank amplification floor(3n/2) above the n budget for mutually annihilating idempotents, and exact extremal multiplicities with full-rank reversed products. This captures orientation-specific interactions invisible in pair counts and provides an exact finite-field formula rather than an arbitrary small computation.
